name: Glass Quarter Optics
description: Mirrored lenses off a concession drone. +13 Signal, +5 Noise.

name: Causeway Coat
description: Lined for a wind that comes off the water all year. +30 Resolve, +6 Grit.

name: Dock Maul
description: A loader's breaker bar, bought cheap on the Halden quayside. +12 Grit.

name: Amendment Folio
description: Four years of drafts she never got to the floor. +15 Signal, +10 Resolve.

name: Tide Line Weave
description: Salvaged from the drowned quarter and stubbornly still itself. +12 Noise, +8 Continuity.

name: Auditor's Badge
description: Your old credential. Still flagged, still opens two doors in Enclave 7. +8 Signal, +15 Resolve.
